title: Editable Host Signs Bundle for Vacation Rental, Wifi Sign, House Rules Sign, Checkout Sign, Short Term Rental Welcome Sign, Canva Template
description:
Eight elegant, ready-to-frame signs that answer your guests' questions before they ask. Edit everything in Canva, print and frame in minutes.

WHAT'S INCLUDED (8 signs, 8 x 10 in)
- Welcome sign
- Wi-Fi sign with QR code spot
- House rules
- Check-out instructions
- Check-in & check-out times
- Trash & recycling
- Quiet hours
- Please remove your shoes

YOU WILL RECEIVE
- A PDF with your Canva template link (free Canva account is enough)
- Print-ready PDF in US Letter and A4 (each sign sized for an 8 x 10 in frame)

EASY TO CUSTOMIZE
Change the text, rules, times, colors and fonts. Add your Wi-Fi QR code. Print at home or at a print shop.

PLEASE NOTE
- This is a DIGITAL product. No physical item or frame will be shipped.
- For use in your own rental properties. Please do not resell or share the template.
- Designed with the help of AI tools, then reviewed and finalized by me.

Want the matching welcome book and cleaning checklist? See the Host Starter Bundle in my shop.
